title: 'Gateless Barrier, Case 30: Ma-tsu: "This Very Mind is Buddha"'
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of this Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of embracing our true nature through meditation practice, rather than grasping onto concepts or ideas about Buddhism. By sitting still and allowing ourselves to be present in the moment, we can let go of distractions and find clarity and acceptance. This approach encourages us to sit with our lives as they are, without judgment or attachment, and to cultivate a sense of courage, gratitude, and interdependence with others.
